jobs.description:
Are you an experienced HR professional looking for a role where you can combine hands-on HR management with strategic organisational development?

Our client is a growing international organisation based in Brussels, with teams across several European countries. As the organisation continues to expand, they are looking for an HR Manager to build and structure their HR function and support their international growth.

This is a broad role with significant autonomy, working closely with leadership and managers across multiple countries.

Your responsibilities as HR Manager

As HR Manager, you will be responsible for developing a lean, scalable and effective HR framework while ensuring excellent day-to-day HR support.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing and structuring recruitment processes in line with the organisation's growth plans.
• Overseeing onboarding, offboarding and employee lifecycle processes.
• Ensuring HR policies and practices are compliant across different European jurisdictions.
• Working with external payroll providers and HR partners.
• Developing and implementing HR policies and processes.
• Supporting managers with performance management, employee development and coaching.
• Developing training and learning initiatives.
• Contributing to workforce planning and organisational development.
• Providing HR insights and data to support strategic decision-making.
• Supporting leadership on employee engagement, wellbeing and company culture.
• Advising managers on HR-related matters and contributing to the development of a strong performance culture.

Your profile as HR Manager

• You have several years of experience in a broad HR management role, ideally within an international environment.
• You have strong experience in recruitment, ideally across different countries.
• You possess a solid understanding of Belgian employment law and HR compliance, particularly in an international context.
• You have experience with performance management, coaching and employee development.
• You are comfortable building and structuring HR processes in a growing organisation.
• You are both strategic and hands-on, happy to move between long-term projects and operational HR matters.
• You are an excellent communicator and confident stakeholder manager.
• You are fluent in English and French ; additional European languages are an asset.
• You are comfortable working in an environment where priorities evolve quickly and where you can genuinely shape the HR function.

Are you an experienced Executive Assistant looking for a challenging role within a prestigious international environment? Do you thrive in a demanding, fast-paced setting where autonomy, proactivity and attention to detail are essential?

For one of our clients, a leading international law firm in Brussels, we are looking for a Senior Executive Assistant to support Partners and Associates within a high-performing team.

Your responsibilities as Executive Assistant

As an Executive Assistant, you will be responsible for:

• Managing complex agendas and coordinating meetings.
• Organising international travel and handling travel arrangements.
• Preparing meetings and taking minutes when required.
• Providing high-level administrative support to Partners and Associates.
• Managing billing and invoicing, which represents a significant part of the role.
• Reviewing billing narratives and coordinating with Associates to ensure they meet client requirements.
• Handling credit notes, write-offs and other billing-related matters.
• Anticipating the needs of the Partners and proactively supporting them in their daily activities.
• Collaborating closely with the wider Assistant team and providing back-up when needed.

Your profile as Executive Assistant

We are looking for a senior, autonomous and proactive Executive Assistant who enjoys taking ownership and working in a demanding environment.

You ideally have:

• Several years of experience as an Executive Assistant, preferably within a law firm, consultancy or similarly demanding environment.
• Strong experience with billing/invoicing and excellent attention to detail.
• Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills.
• A proactive, hands-on and solution-oriented mindset.
• The confidence to work with senior stakeholders and demanding personalities.
• A stable career history and a mature professional attitude.
• Excellent English skills with French and/or Dutch.
Above all, you are someone who anticipates, takes initiative and does not need to be micromanaged. You are confident, discreet and comfortable working with demanding personalities. Your personality and ability to build trust with the Partners will be just as important as your experience.

Service Technician 
 

Are you someone who enjoys solving technical problems and helping customers? Do you like working independently while also contributing ideas for improvements and new technical projects? Then this opportunity could be the right fit for you.
 

For a company based in the 
Roeselare region, we are looking for a Service Technician who enjoys a varied role. You will work in a technical environment where maintenance, installations, troubleshooting, and project work go hand in hand.
 

Your Responsibilities
 
 

• Diagnose and resolve electrical and mechanical failures at customer sites. 

• Perform preventive maintenance on a variety of technical installations. 

• Assist with the installation and commissioning of new systems. 

• Contribute to technical improvements and new projects. 

• Act as a point of contact for customers and provide technical advice when needed. 

• Ensure proper follow-up and after-sales support following completed work.  

You will work on a range of systems, including:
 
 

• Water treatment and irrigation installations such as pumps, valves, and PVC piping systems. 

• Mechanical and hydraulic installations. 

• Climate control and irrigation management systems. 

• Electrical installations, switchboards, cabling, and LED lighting systems.  

If you have an interest in design and engineering, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the development and optimization of electrical control panels.

Your profile
 
 

• You hold a degree in Electricity, Electromechanics, or a similar technical field. 

• You enjoy combining hands-on technical work with problem-solving and analytical thinking. 

• You are flexible and enjoy a diverse range of tasks. 

• You work accurately and take ownership of your responsibilities. 

• Experience as a service technician or in technical project work is an asset. 

• You have a good command of Dutch or English. 

• You possess a valid cat B driving license.

Our client, a well-established company based in Brussels, is looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Payroll Officer to join their HR team. As part of a small but dynamic structure, you will play a key role in the day-to-day payroll and HR administration. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a multicultural environment and enjoys working with accuracy and autonomy.

Responsibilities as a Payroll Officer:

- Ensure the accurate and timely processing of payroll for employees in Belgium
 - Be the point of contact for payroll-related questions from employees
 - Liaise with the external payroll provider (e.g. Partena) to ensure data integrity
 - Maintain employee records and ensure compliance with local social legislation
 - Assist with HR administrative tasks such as contracts, insurance, and benefits
 - Support the HR team with onboarding and general employee queries

Profile for a Payroll Officer:

- You have proven experience in payroll processing, ideally in Belgium
 - You are fluent in German with a good command of French, English and/or Dutch
 - You are detail-oriented, discreet, and able to handle confidential information
 - You are proactive, organized, and capable of managing priorities independently
 - Familiarity with Partena or a similar payroll provider is a strong asset
 - Good knowledge of Excel and HR tools is expected

Responsibilities

• Review incoming business and user requirements to ensure completeness, consistency, and technical feasibility.
• Translate business needs into detailed functional specifications, including user stories, acceptance criteria, and system behavior.
• Specify system-to-system integrations, including interface payloads, error handling, and non-functional performance constraints.
• Collaborate with architects, developers, and testers to maintain clarity and resolve implementation questions.
• Maintain project documentation and support defect review and User Acceptance Testing campaigns.
• Perform data investigations and validate business rules by directly querying systems.

Requirements

• 3+ years of professional experience in functional analysis, including the production of user stories, acceptance criteria, and business rules.
• You possess professional experience specifying system-to-system integrations using REST APIs, SOAP APIs, JSON, and XML.
• You bring a proven ability to write SQL queries independently for data investigation and defect qualification.
• You have experience using Atlassian JIRA and Confluence to author and maintain technical specifications.
• You possess knowledge of non-functional constraints such as latency, throughput, and system availability.
• You're experienced in working within a delivery model where functional analysis is distinct from business analysis.
• You are fluent in English at a C1 level with at least B2 level proficiency in Dutch or French.
Nice to Haves

• Knowledge of modeling notations such as BPMN or UML.
• Experience with API contract design using OpenAPI or Swagger.
• Familiarity with conceptual and logical data modelling and entity-relationship analysis.
• Participation in defect triage and test preparation within complex environments.

Our client is a global leader in integrated solutions for the airport/aviation industry. With design and consulting teams across Europe, Africa, and Asia, the company delivers high-impact airside infrastructure projects worldwide.

 To strengthen its European Design & Consulting team, ADB Safegate is currently looking for a  Designer based in Belgium.

Jobomschrijving

 

Your main responsibilities include:

• Managing airside design and consulting projects from concept to execution
• Coordinating multidisciplinary teams (designers, technicians, external consultants)
• Producing and reviewing technical reports, engineering calculations, and design documentation
• Developing airside infrastructure designs (lighting, signage, markings, cabling, AVDGS systems, etc.)
• Preparing bill of quantities and technical specifications for tendering and project execution
• Ensuring compliance with ICAO standards and aviation regulations
• Providing technical support during installation, testing, and commissioning phases
• Communicating effectively with clients and internal stakeholders, presenting design solutions
• Identifying opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement in tools, processes, and systems

• Fluent in English 
• Based in Belgium or willing to relocate

Our client is an international industrial company operating a complex manufacturing environment with a strong focus on operational excellence and energy efficiency.

Jobomschrijving

• Solid knowledge of high-voltage and low-voltage electrical systems, energy regulations, and industrial compliance requirements.
• Autonomous, proactive, solution-oriented, and able to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
• Fluent in Dutch and English

If you enjoy working on real robots in real environments and want to see your software operating in 

the field, this role offers the opportunity to make a tangible impact in a fast-growing and innovative 

sector.
 

This is what your job will look like:
 

As a robotic engineer, you will be part of our driven engineering team, where you will work together to 

develop high-quality software solutions. Your tasks will include:
 
 

• Develop, maintain, and improve robotic software using 
ROS2 

• Integrate and optimize 
navigation stacks, SLAM, and sensor fusion 

• Build perception systems using 
Computer Vision (e.g., object detection, visual localization) 

• Design and deploy 
Machine Learning models for robotic perception and autonomous decisionmaking 

• Work hands-on with real robots: system integration, deployment, tuning, and performance 

optimization 

• Contribute to robot control, localization, and path planning 

• Participate in on-site testing and customer deployments across Belgium and the Netherlands  

That's why this job suits you:
 
 

• You are hands-on and have 3-5 years of experience and strong affinity with autonomous navigation, robotics, machine control or industrial automation 

• Thorough knowledge of 
ROS2, C, C++, and Python 

• Solid knowledge in majority of the following fields: 
 

• Sensor fusion for state estimation and localization 

• Control systems for robotics 

• Path planning & Navigation (SLAM) 

• Computer Vision and Machine Learning applied to robotics   

• You’re comfortable working with hardware and in realworld field environments and experience bringing systems from prototype to reliable field deployment 

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your work 

• You have a valid EU driving license (for site testing and deployments) 

• You can communicate fluently in English
